name: Epub Viewer
description: Field formatter that turns an EPUB (application/epub+zip) file-field value into a link that opens the file in a bundled in-browser e-book reader.

suggests.color_field: When the color_field module is enabled, the settings form's colour fields render as HTML5 colour pickers instead of plain text fields.

project_description: Epub Viewer (project epub_viewer, machine name epub_module) adds a single field formatter, 'Epub Formatter' (id epub_field_formatter), that applies to core file fields. For a file whose MIME type is application/epub+zip it renders a link that opens the file in an in-browser e-book reader served from the route /view-ebook/{fid}; non-EPUB files fall back to the standard file link. The reader and all of its assets (a bundled epub.js/JSZip based reader, jQuery UI, icon fonts and CSS) ship inside the module, so no external library must be installed. A small admin settings form at /admin/config/epub/epubsettings lets you set the reader's background, icon and font colours and toggle a download icon. It requires no other contrib modules and supports Drupal 9.3, 10 and 11.
